Unusual and delicious cocktails, amazing service
Jun 2025 • Family
An amazing bar with very unusual cocktails. It's hard to find: the path is covered with bushes and trees, but the search was worth it. 
The bartenders are very helpful, welcoming and professional. They come up on time, make sure you always have water, comment on your choice and emphasize what the drink will taste like. If you don't know what you want, they'll suggest drinks based on your wishes. Also willing to stir author cocktails off the menu.
The drinks themselves are delicious! We haven't tried this anywhere, although we go to cocktail bars regularly and in different countries. 
The price tag is higher than the Nha Trang average, but it's worth it! It's a great place to sit tonight.

Step in with an open mind and empty stomach
Oct 2023 • Friends
This hidden gem is perfect for those seeking unique and delicious cocktails and cuisine. Nestled at the far end of an alley, it truly embraces the concept of a tucked-away treasure. You'll venture past quaint backyard scenes, adding to the excitement of the journey. Stepping into this establishment transports you to a completely different world, complemented perfectly by the thoughtfully curated cocktail menu. 

Our group indulged in an array of delights from the Hybrid selection and savored the Baguette with Crab dip, Chicken skin cracker and beef gyoza — each dish hitting the mark. If you find yourself in Nha Trang, make sure to pay this spot a visit!

Finally a bar of note in Nha Trang!
Oct 2019
Another hidden gem in Nha Trang. Hybrid is cocktail bar of sophistication and elegance. Owner Anh Lam (Liam) has put together a weekly cocktail menu and a great selection of spirits and liqueurs to tantalize your taste buds. After a wonderful evening out we popped in to enjoy some digestive cocktails, the idea was to have one, but we tried one of each on the menu. A limited menu, I suspect to make you want to come back for more. Mr. Lam changes the menu each week, so for me it will be a place to go to weekly, potentially twice a week when this expert mixologist creates something truly memorable. Whilst we didn't eat we saw some of the bar food go out and had we not just had dinner we would have ordered some, elegant and themed to compliment the cocktails. The bar set up is also quite unique, a combination of a laboratory and cleverly thought out purpose built cleaning surfaces. Great to have you here with us in Nha Trang Hybrid.
